units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:7:4">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵇ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 11a:3">R. Hash. 11ᵃ</cite> what month is it <he>שהארץ מוציאה ד׳ וכ׳</he> in which the earth produces fresh green while the trees are full of fruits?—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 11a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>הארץ מליאה ד׳</he> the ground is covered with herbs.
